{{Top|leg}}
'''Encapsulated arcology''' was a style of architectural design incorporating arcology within an encapsulating structure. Notable examples include the [[Ralthhok Encapsulization]] and the [[Blackstar wheelworld]] in the [[Sagar system/Legends|Sagar system]]. Both were designed by the famous [[Architect/Legends|architect]] [[Teela Kaarz]], who specialized in this architecture style.<ref name="DS">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref>
